_doc: Balance numbers (P1-06, doc 04). Read through scripts/domain/balance.gd (Balance.num('section.key')); tools/validate_data.py checks every key, type and range. Chances are 0-1; percent points are 0-100. Other tuning lives next to its system: statuses.json (status durations, caps), progression.json (XP, difficulty, skill ranks), camp_skills.json, town_events.json, items.json (prices), region JSONs (map generator, light).

combat._doc: Hit = hit_base + (accuracy + skill accuracy - dodge) * hit_per_point, clamped hit_min..hit_max. Crit chance capped at crit_cap; crits deal x crit_mult. Protection is capped at prot_cap %. Guard: physical damage x guard_mult. A hero who misses gains miss_stress; a crit leaves them Encarrerado for encarrerado_turns. Enemies without 'crit' in enemies.json use enemy_base_crit. Dragging fights (P5-02b, DD stall penalty): at the start of every round from drag_round on (drag_round_boss against a boss), each living hero gains drag_stress, plus drag_stress_step for every round after that one. Retreat (P5-04, as in Darkest Dungeon): on a hero's turn the party may try to leave the fight; it works with retreat_chance (a failed try spends the turn) and costs every living hero retreat_stress.

crits._doc: Doc 01 §2.3 stress shock (owner 2026-11-11, Darkest Dungeon style): a hero's crit relieves party_relief stress for every living hero; an enemy crit adds enemy_crit_stress to the hero hit.

death._doc: Doc 01 §2.4 Al Borde death roll: base = default 'golpe_de_gracia' % (heroes.json may set their own); minus check_penalty per earlier roll this expedition; minus the highest stress_penalties entry [stress, points] that applies; minus collapse_penalty on a Colapso (doc 01 §3.4). The cap is statuses.json deathblow_cap.

stress._doc: Doc 01 §3: resolve check at resolve_threshold (Quebranto with quebranto_chance, else Virtud, which resets stress to virtud_reset); Colapso at colapso (also the stress cap); surviving a Colapso while Al Borde leaves colapso_survive. Hero stress_resist is clamped to stress_resist_min..stress_resist_max; status resistances to status_resist_cap.

afflictions._doc: Quebranto / Virtud behaviour (doc 01 §3.3; stat changes are statuses.json mental_mods). Chances 0-1.

enemies._doc: Room squads: the leader gets boss_hp_mult (boss rooms) or elite_hp_mult (elite rooms); everyone else's HP is scaled by squad_hp_scale[squad size] (index 0-4).

hub._doc: Hacienda prices (item prices are in items.json). The Pulpería buys back at sell_rate of the price (owner rule). EBAIS: heal_cost_per_hp per missing PV, at least heal_min_cost. Iglesia Vieja / Cantina activity prices are in hub_activities.json. idle_stress_relief (P5-02): a hero who spends the week at home without a booking loses this much stress. tier_price_mult (P3-14, doc 04 §3.2): EBAIS and Iglesia/Cantina prices × this by the hero's resolve tier (quirks.tier_levels: levels 0–2, 3–4, 5–6); building upgrades (data/upgrades.json) bring them back down.

camp._doc: Guardabosques del Arenal (P3-13, doc 02 §9, owner 2026-11-19). A new hero knows known_at_hire of their class's 6 camp skills (at random); learn_price teaches one more. fix_price makes one known class skill come up at every fogata (letting it go is free). shared_swap_price swaps one of the hero's 2 shared camp skills for the third. Each fogata draws camp_skills.json class_skills_per_camp of the known class skills.

quirks._doc: Quirks (P3-06, data/quirks.json). After each expedition every hero who went may gain at most one new quirk (owner 2026-11-19: it was too common): positive_chance, negative_chance and disease_chance are rolled in random order and the first hit wins; at max_positive / max_negative a new one replaces a random unlocked one (none if all are locked). Recruits arrive with one of each with recruit_positive_chance / recruit_negative_chance. Clínica prices (doc 04 §3.5) by resolve tier: levels below tier_levels[0], below tier_levels[1], the rest. Each hero: one negative removal and one positive lock/removal per week; diseases any time.

limits._doc: Owner 2026-11-12: tunable limits. The party size (4) stays in code: the stage, positions 1-4 and the hub are built around it.

hunger._doc: Travel hunger (P1-18, DD hunger checks). Every every_moves moves the party stops to eat: 1 gallo pinto per living hero. A hero who doesn't eat loses hp_pct of max PV (never below 1) and gains stress. A camp meal resets the count.

light._doc: Torch light (Luz) ranges 0..max (P1-17, DD torch). tiers: brightest first; a tier applies from its min up to the next one. Per tier: hero_accuracy (accuracy points added to hero attacks; each point is combat.hit_per_point), enemy_dmg_pct and enemy_crit (added to enemy attacks), stress_pct (stress heroes take in combat), loot_pct (colones from fights and curios), party_surprised_pct / enemies_surprised_pct (chance a normal fight opens with that side acting first), trap_pct (added to the disarm chance), move_stress and move_stress_all (stress per move to one random hero, or to everyone), low (counts as low light for the camp ambush). snuff: Luz lost when the player puts out the candle. Rules: scripts/domain/light_system.gd.

upgrades._doc: Reliquias del Abuelo (P3-16): chance that an elite fight or a killed roaming mini-boss leaves one Reliquia. Objective Reliquias are per difficulty in progression.json; curios may give them (outcome `reliquias`).

drops._doc: Enemy drops (P5-10, data/enemies.json drops): chance multiplier per difficulty (times the Luz/event loot multiplier), and the most one enemy's three chances may add up to after every multiplier.

feria._doc: Feria Nocturna (P3-05a, doc 02 §8): the accessory stall. Each week it brings stock_size different accessories, one of each, rerolled when the week turns. Accessories dearer than cheap_price are rarer early: their draw weight grows from pricey_min_weight in week 1 to 1 by full_stock_week. Cursed accessories (items.json cursed, P3-05b) never come in the normal draw: each week, at cursed_chance, one of them is added to the stall on top.

taller._doc_stock: Taller weekly stock (P3-05e, owner 2026-11-22; same draw as the Feria): each week the Taller brings stock_weapons different weapons and stock_armor different armors, one of each, rerolled when the week turns; a bought one is gone until next week. Items dearer than cheap_price are rarer early: their draw weight grows from pricey_min_weight in week 1 to 1 by full_stock_week.
taller._doc: Taller weapon and armor ranks (P3-05d, doc 04 §3.4, DD blacksmith): each hero's weapon slot and armor slot go from rank 1 to max_rank; rank N costs rank_costs[N] colones (doc 04 had 900/1900/3400/5600, lowered to sit next to skill ranks) and the last rank also top_rank_reliquias Reliquias (doc 04's infernal fragments). Each rank above 1 adds the per_rank numbers while something is worn in that slot. The Taller's upgrade tracks (data/upgrades.json) cap the rank and discount the price.
